column1: # Bloom scenes: Tolbi harbour, Altin Peak miner, Mogall aftermath.

column3: Isaac, the harbor. Someone\nis screaming down there.{end_wait}
It's a little boy, out on\nthe pier. He's alone.{end_wait}
Leave it. The water takes\nwhat it takes.{end_wait}
He's not screaming at the\nwater. He's screaming at\nwhat he's hearing.{end_wait}
He woke up, Isaac. His\neyes are grey. We got him\nunder cover. It's not much.{end_wait}
We can't carry every\nchild in this town.{end_wait}
The screaming stopped.\nI wish I'd never heard\nit stop.{end_wait}
Why did you pull me out?\nIt's so loud in the light.{end_wait}
His thoughts went quiet\nall at once, Isaac.{end_wait}
Look at his eyes, Isaac.\nThey're grey.{end_wait}
Thank you. Don't go yet.\nI don't want to be alone\nwhen it takes me.{end_wait}
He's not in there anymore.\nDon't watch him, Isaac.{end_wait}
The boy in Tolbi is still\nbreathing. That counts.{end_wait}
I keep seeing that pier,\nIvan. I can't stop.{end_wait}
